purpose: Learn interfaces where selecting a list item opens a detail pane or detail page.
applies_when: The screen has repeated list/card items.
Selecting an item reveals a richer detail area.
Card text is insufficient for the Agent's final content decision.
trace_requirements: Record list item/card identity before click.
Record detail header identity after click.
Record scoped scroll evidence for the detail region.
success_conditions: The opened detail identity matches the selected list item.
The latest detail snapshot is available for downstream decisions.
Detail scrolling does not move the list region.

seek_source.lesson: SEEK cards are only entry evidence; full job detail must be opened, verified, and read before suitability review.
